INDIVIDUAL HISTORY

Scoring & working assumptions

The mentor’s PDF supplies the score. This dashboard recalculates from raw responses and ignores the spreadsheet’s score columns.

PracticeBands → marks
Chanting≥100%, ≥80%, >50%, >0%, zero → 20, 15, 10, 8, 0
Reading / hearing≥100%, ≥70%, ≥50%, ≥20%, <20% → 20, 15, 10, 5, 0
SleepingBefore 22:00 / 23:00 / midnight / after midnight → 20, 15, 8, 4
WakingBy 05:00 / 06:00 / 07:00 / later → 20, 15, 8, 4

Visible, editable assumptions

Default targets are 16 rounds, 60 minutes reading and 60 minutes hearing. Confirm personal targets in a student’s history. Targets apply to the loaded history in this tab and are cleared on reload.

Reporting is expected daily across the selected period for all listed names. Enrollment and absence dates are not available. A missing report is unknown practice, and is still a reporting concern. Start and end dates are inclusive. Presets fill a range ending yesterday in Asia/Kolkata, avoiding a penalty for today. Imported files do not change your selected dates.

For duplicate person/date entries, the latest timestamp wins; duplicates remain flagged. Future practice dates and invalid dates are excluded from practice history. An invalid activity value stays unknown; a total score is shown only when all five components can be read.

The period uses practice dates; submission dates separately show reporting activity and delay. Export clock values are interpreted as local Asia/Kolkata wall times. CSV dates must use ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) or M/D/YYYY; ambiguous formats are flagged.

Midnight is placed in the 4-point sleep band; sleep times before noon are treated as after midnight. Decimal numeric clock values such as 3.45 are flagged rather than guessed. Name casing and surrounding whitespace are normalized. Other spelling differences remain separate.

Trend compares the first and second halves of the selected period and needs at least three known observations in each half. It describes change in reported values, not proven improvement or deterioration. The score view’s ≥80 highlight and reporting filters are exploratory thresholds, not rules from the PDF.

This version uses file imports, not a live connection to Google Forms. No messages are sent to students.
